request.prompt: Cozy whimsical fantasy inn game, crisp hand-placed-looking pixel art, readable chunky shapes, limited muted moss green and warm brown palette, restrained shading, no text, no interface, no blur. A straight interior wall section for the rear wall of a top-down forest inn RPG room, facing the viewer. Warm buff plaster across the upper half, muted walnut wainscoting across the lower half and a narrow dark wooden baseboard at the floor. Simple restrained horizontal bands of color continuous across left and right borders. Fully opaque. No door, window, frame, corner, objects or outside landscape.
